_comment_integration: Standalone-house district (Docs/Locations/Plan_ResidentialDistricts.md 2.1). One world door at (390,200), floorExitID houses_entrance, listed in world.json initializeFactions. Homes are built on demand by AssignResidence / console spawnResident (ResidenceUtility.CreateResidence), all linked to the entrance. Only the 4LDK house (existing house_floor_4ldk) is listed; add the 3LDK house once its floor plan and art exist. The authored Katsuragi / Miyama / Kiryu households are homes of this district too: world.json initializeResidences registers them here (ResidenceUtility.AdoptResidence) with their own IDs, counting as jp_home_tpl_house_4ldk - see Docs/Locations/Plan_HouseholdsIntoDistricts.md.
